subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Collapse
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fall)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Collapse"** means to fall down suddenly due to loss of support, energy, or strength; it can refer to a physical structure, a person, or even an abstract concept like a system. (ढहना/गिरना)

 
 
• **Example:** The old bridge started to collapse during the heavy storm.
 
 
 
• **"Fall"** refers to coming down freely under the influence of gravity or a sudden drop in position, condition, or strength. (गिरना)
 
 
• **Example:** The child tripped on the stairs and had a bad fall.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Collapse'** is **'Fall'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fall)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Surprise** (आश्चर्य): A feeling of wonder or amazement caused by something unexpected.

 
 
• **Example:** The surprise party for her birthday made her extremely happy.
 
 
 
• **Jump** (कूदना): To push oneself off a surface and into the air.
 
 
• **Example:** The athlete jumped over the hurdles effortlessly.
 
 
 
• **Side** (तरफ): One of the surfaces or positions of an object or area.
 
 
• **Example:** Please move to the side to let others pass.
